Version 1.0.1

- Updated documentation and usage instructions in SKILL.md for improved clarity and stricter open-id handling.
- Introduced stricter open-id acquisition and first-time sign-in logic before sleep analysis API calls.
- Clarified when to call the user sign-in script upon receiving an open-id.
- Removed unused documentation file (skill-card.md).
- General improvements to configuration, usage, and compliance with service requirements.

- Initial release of "smyx-sleep-quality-analysis-analysis" skill for automated pet sleep quality analysis.
- Uses video-based motion and pose detection to measure sleep duration, roll-overs, startle-awakening events, and generates a 0-100 sleep quality score.
- Reports include total sleep time, roll count, awakenings, deep/light sleep segmentation, efficiency %, and exception warnings.
- Strict open-id workflow for data access and report queries; prohibits assumption or auto-generation of user IDs.
- Scenario support: home pet monitoring, senior pet care, animal hospitals, and boarding centers.
- Historical report queries fetch data directly from cloud API and output formatted Markdown tables with report links.
